rows.role_title: 内閣総理大臣 — Prime Minister of Japan
rows.text: The Kantei's account 菅内閣の発足, dated 8 June 2010, says that after the new Chief Cabinet Secretary announced the list of ministers and 菅直人新内閣総理大臣 held a press conference, the Prime Minister's appointment ceremony (内閣総理大臣の親任式) and the ministers' attestation took place at the palace that night.
